manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 16 fresh complete operational mappings balanced eight per registered form
manifest.selection: Sixteen wholly fresh operational clauses and immutable references were frozen before tokenizer import, with eight fact gaps and eight unsettled authorized choices. Each English comparator states the complete registered meaning and exclusions; no bare or abbreviated English control is used.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus complete-English tokens for every pair under each pinned encoding; average within each form stratum, weight the two form strata equally, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta. Retain every finite outcome.

estimand.population: the 16 fresh complete pairs retained in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: equal form-stratum mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: the proposal's complete careful-English mapping, never bare or abbreviated English
estimand.interpretation: token cost only; no claim about comprehension, fidelity, reference validity, or adoption

manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before this process imported tiktoken or observed token counts.
